text:
Taylor M: Heads-up: ran a small experiment on forcing a follow-up cadence after last week's outage. Quick notes and a proposed 'mini PM' template to keep owners honest.

Ravi S: Love experiments. Share the mini PM template.

Taylor M: Template: 3 fields only so it's easier to update in the first 48h:
- Owner + backup
- 2-week objective (1 line)
- Verification (metrics + duration)
Plus optional tags: recurrence, blocking-dep, rollback-window.

Dana H: Short and sweet. What about comms? We need a one-liner stakeholders can forward.

Taylor M: Add this comms snippet to each mini PM: "Status: In progress. Owner: X. Risk: low/med/high. ETA: YYYY-MM-DD. Contact: @X"

Ravi S: For IC rotation, could we add a 'handoff checklist' field on the mini PM so the outgoing IC explicitly hands off context? E.g., links to logs, runbook, temp fixes.

Dana H: Also suggest a weekly 10-min check where the backup IC leads and the primary gives a 2-min handover. This will train backups and surface knowledge gaps.

ops-bot: Created reminder: 2w-mini-pm-sync Tue 10:00 starting 1823295600

Taylor M: If this works, we can migrate to the incident playbook. Pilot owners: Ravi will pilot for the next infra incident, Dana will observe.

Ravi S: I'll pilot. Will post the mini PM in channel when I start.

Dana H: I'll take notes and suggest edits after pilot.

Taylor M: Action items:
- Taylor: add mini PM snippet to playbook (due 4 days)
- Ravi: pilot on next incident (start when incident occurs)
- Dana: collect feedback and suggest improvements (due 2 weeks after pilot)

Ravi S: +1

Dana H: +1

Taylor M: Thanks team. Short templates + enforced cadence seems to reduce drift.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2w-mini-pm-sync recurring starting 1823295600

Ravi S: Will post pilot results in 3 weeks.

Taylor M: Great, closing thread.
